result.title: AgentCT: A Vision-Language Agent for Universal CT Imaging
result.summary: Computed tomography (CT) restoration methods often use a single network for low-dose CT (LDCT), sparse-view CT (SVCT), and metal artifact reduction (MAR), despite the distinct physics of these degradations. We propose AgentCT, a vision-language agent that identifies the degradation and routes images to task-specific restoration models. A LoRA-adapted Qwen3-VL-4B controller predicts degradation type and severity, selects a specialist, and reassesses the restored image. The LDCT specialist uses an image-domain diffusion model, whereas the SVCT and MAR specialists combine projection-domain correction, data consistency, differentiable filtered back-projection, and image refinement. We evaluated the controller and specialists separately on patient-disjoint Mayo 2020 abdominal CT data across three severity levels for each degradation. The controller achieved 95.7% accuracy for degradation type and 93.9% for severity, with a 100% JSON parse rate. Using ground-truth degradation labels for routing, AgentCT achieved an overall PSNR/SSIM of 46.18 dB/0.984, compared with 44.93 dB/0.976 for AMIR and 44.29 dB/0.979 for TAMP, and attained the highest PSNR in all nine settings. For SVCT, its dual-domain specialist achieved 46.04 dB with 4.2 million parameters, compared with 44.43 dB for single-task AMIR and 43.57 dB for all-in-one AMIR with 23.5 million parameters. These results support degradation-specific CT restoration with controller-based model selection; evaluation under automatic routing and on independent clinical data remains necessary. Code is available at https://github.com/hao1635/AgentCT.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AgentCT，用 LoRA 微调的 Qwen3-VL-4B 控制器判断 CT 退化类型与严重程度，将图像路由到 LDCT／SVCT／MAR 专用修复模型，并对修复结果再做一次评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 控制器的退化类型／严重度预测与「再评估」环节属于 VLM 依据视觉证据做选择与自检的线索，可为研究视觉证据筛选与停止／验收决策提供参照；但工作对象是医学图像修复，未涉及 latent 推理状态或内部表示。
